name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Unrack with locked elbows and lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press up in a slight arc until elbows lock without bouncing.
Keep shoulder blades pinched and a natural arch in the back.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: The king of lower body exercises, building absolute strength and muscle mass across the entire lower body.
instructions: Rest the bar across your upper traps and unrack.
Step back, set feet shoulder-width apart with toes slightly out.
Break at the hips and knees, descending until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your mid-foot to return to the starting position.

name: Pull-Up
description: An upper body staple focusing on lat width, upper back thickness, and grip strength.
instructions: Grab the bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with fully extended arms and engaged core.
Pull your chest up to the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself under control to the starting hang position.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: A full-body posterior chain movement designed to develop tremendous raw pulling power.
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the barbell, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Drop your hips, flatten your back, and pull the slack out of the bar.
Drive the floor away, locking out your hips and knees at the top.

name: Overhead Press
description: The ultimate test of strict upper body pushing strength, targeting shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core tightly and squeeze your glutes for stability.
Press the bar straight up overhead, moving your head out of the way.
Lock out your elbows overhead and safely lower back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: A compound pull movement that builds thick upper back muscles and rear deltoids.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees.
Keep your spine neutral and core braced tightly.
Pull the barbell toward your lower ribs or belly button.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak and lower smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: An isolation exercise targeting the lateral deltoids to build wider-looking shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Briefly pause at the top position.
Lower the dumbbells back down to your sides in a controlled motion.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: A classic arm-building movement to develop bicep mass and peak strength.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder-width.
Keep your elbows pinned close to your sides.
Curl the bar upward toward your chest by contracting your biceps.
Lower the weight back down slowly with full extension.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: An effective cable exercise for isolating and building tricep definition.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip it with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows locked in place by your ribs.
Push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly to the starting position with control.

name: Plank
description: An isometric core hold that strengthens the deep abdominal muscles and lower back.
instructions: Get into a forearm support position with elbows directly under shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes tightly.
Hold the position steadily without letting your hips sag.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A unilateral leg exercise that builds single-leg strength, stability, and glute activation.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and place one foot behind you on top of it.
Step your front foot forward to ensure a safe stance.
Lower your hips straight down until your back knee is just above the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: An isolation exercise designed to develop lower leg calf size and endurance.
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform with heels hanging off.
Hold dumbbells in your hands for added resistance if desired.
Raise your heels as high as possible by flexing your calves.
Lower your heels past the platform level to get a full stretch.
